text:
marta: Quick ops thread for Orbitix customer spotlight. Recording set Thu 10am PT. Need: customer quote, signed release, benchmark graphic, and lead routing for the launch.

liam: I can handle the quote. Can someone confirm the latency improvement percent we should cite?

raj: Orbitix reported a 43% reduction in tail latency after moving to Redwood Dedicated. I'll confirm again with them today.

marta: Great. @liam please craft a one-liner and @olivia make sure release form is with the right POC.

olivia: Sending the standard release + consent language now to marketing@orbitix.io. cc'ing legal. Will set a Thu AM reminder.

sara: Legal note: do not publish revenue or customer-specific traffic numbers. Percent improvements and anonymized metrics are fine. If they request edits to the quote, we need signed redlines.

liam: Draft quote: `Redwood's dedicated runtime reduced our end-to-end inference latency by ~43%, letting us scale query capacity without rearchitecting infra.` Feedback?

raj: Add a short reliability note: Orbitix cares about SLO stability. Maybe append: "and improved overall request reliability."

liam: Updated: `Redwood's dedicated runtime reduced our end-to-end inference latency by ~43%, letting us scale query capacity without rearchitecting infra and improving request reliability.`

olivia: Release form delivered to Orbitix. I'll post signed PDF here when returned.

deploy-bot: Draft created at /drafts/orbitix-launch.md awaiting approved label.

marta: For distribution: blog post + LinkedIn + one-pager. Also want a small webinar to surface this to users. Routing rule: people who view the Orbitix case page should flow to SDR queue 'Sector-North'. @olivia can you implement tracking param and webhook?

olivia: Will add ?case=orbitix and a webhook mapping leads -> Sector-North. I'll share webhook id after I set it up.

raj: I'll export a latency vs baseline PNG from dashboards by Wed AM and drop in Drive (/assets/orbitix).

liam: If legal signs off, I'll finalize hero copy Thu morning and send to @marta for scheduling.

olivia: Signed release received — uploaded: /releases/orbitix_signed_release_374901.pdf.

sara: Confirmed release language included. Legal okay with quote as written since metric confirmed.

marta: Awesome. Checklist: 1) Final copy (liam) — due Thu 9am, 2) Benchmark graphic (raj) — Wed AM, 3) Release uploaded (olivia) — done, 4) Lead routing (olivia) — in progress, 5) Publish on Fri 9am PT if all green.

liam: Will post final copy here by 9am Thu.

marta: Thanks all. We'll loop in comms for the webinar invite once landing copy is ready. :sparkles:
